name: IMMOFINANZ AG
summary: IMMOFINANZ AG acquires, develops, owns, rents, and manages properties primarily in Austria, Germany, Poland, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Romania, Slovakia, and internationally. It develops office, retail, and other properties. The company manages offices under myhive brand; retail parks under STOP SHOP brand; and shopping centers under VIVO! brand. As of December 31, 2020, it had a property portfolio of approximately 209 properties. The company is headquartered in Vienna, Austria.
